data.body: **[P2] Flush spans ended during the previous provider wait.** With `BatchSpanProcessor`, the new late-step scenario can end its step, attempt, and child continuation after the current flush captured its batch. Ordinary lifecycle completion leaves `externalCompletions.pending` empty, so this condition exits despite remaining budget. The final `endOpenSpans()` can also enqueue spans without another flush. These spans remain buffered when Lambda freezes and may never be delivered. Track spans ended since each flush began, close invocation state, and flush the final batch within the remaining deadline, as the execution view does. Extend the late-span regression with `BatchSpanProcessor` and assert delivery before provider shutdown.
